title: Smoky Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender lamb and a rich, smoky flavor.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Add onion to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, smoky paprika, and Syrian chili flakes to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and diced tomatoes to pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Return lamb to pot and bring to a boil.
Cover pot and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
